subject: Re: MSA / Order Form — security exhibit, pen-test window & evidence cadence
messages:
From: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@healthsync.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@healthsync.com
Date: 2026-06-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Security exhibit questions + pen test window options

Hi Mateo —

Thanks for the draft MSA/order form. We ran the security exhibit by our security ops team and had a few follow-ups before legal signs off:

1) Pen test window — we need a 48-hour notice and a max 72-hour testing window for external vendor tests. Can Redwood confirm acceptable scheduling windows (US PST preferred) and an escalation contact?

2) SOC 2 evidence — we will request access to monthly SOC 2 monitoring logs and a summary of the last rolling 12 months. Is that available through an evidence portal or will this be periodic exports?

3) Audit rights — we prefer a sampled inspection clause (no more than once per 12 months) with 2–3 business days on-site or virtual evidence handover. How does Redwood propose to support scoped evidence slates?

I've attached our vendor questionnaire and highlighted the exhibit areas. If you can share a redlined exhibit and proposed cadence, we can route to legal this week.

Appreciate it —
Alice
Alice Gomez
Senior Security Program Manager | HealthSync Inc.
security@healthsync.com
Attachment: HealthSync_Vendor_Questionnaire_2026.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@healthsync.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-16T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit questions + pen test window options

Thanks Alice — this is helpful context. Quick answers and next steps below then I'll loop legal for redlines.

- Pen test window: We can support 48-hour notice and a default 72-hour testing window for external vendor tests. We operate a controlled pen-test rota and can set PST windows (we typically schedule Mon–Thu 09:00–17:00 PST). We will provide a named ops contact for coordination.

- SOC 2 evidence: SOC 2 reports and a limited set of monthly monitoring artifacts can be provided via a secure S3 share/temporary links. For active customers we also offer an evidence portal (read-only exports) on an enterprise plan; otherwise we prepare periodic exports.

- Audit rights/sampling: Redwood prefers timeboxed, scoped inspections — we can accept one sampled inspection per 12 months with a pre-agreed evidence matrix. We'll need to define "scoped" (roles, systems, and data slices) and agree on redaction rules for audit logs.

Next steps: I've attached our working exhibit (Redwood_Security_Exhibit_v2.docx) with inline comments on SOC2/pen-test language and an example PenTest_Window_Options.xlsx. Laura from legal and Karthik from product infra are cc'd to confirm language and operational feasibility.

If you have a quick 30-min slot tomorrow we can walk through the redlines and lock cadence.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai
Attachments: Redwood_Security_Exhibit_v2.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document); PenTest_Window_Options.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@healthsync.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-17T08:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit questions + pen test window options

Hi all — looping in legal comments attached inline. High-level positions:

- Pen test: Accept 48-hour notice / 72-hour window for customer-led tests, with the following guardrails: tests must be limited to non-production endpoints (if agreed), or conducted in a disclosed maintenance window; test plan must be shared 72 hours in advance; Redwood provides a single ops point of contact and will suspend testing if business-impacting behavior is detected.

- SOC2 / evidence: We cannot provide raw production logs continuously; instead we will provide SOC 2 Type II reports and a curated evidence bundle aligned to your questionnaire. For customers on Dedicated/Private plans we can offer broader access mechanics. We propose quarterly evidence exports plus ad-hoc exports for critical items.

- Audit rights / sampling: We will accept one scoped inspection per 12 months. Scope must be documented in the order form appendix (systems, artifacts, read-only log samples). Any deeper forensic review or full-scope audit requires a separate agreement and can be scheduled with 30 days' notice.

I've made specific redlines in the attached Word doc (look for comments labeled LB). If HealthSync wants more permissive access (e.g., on-site log review), we should discuss a dedicated evidence access addendum and potential commercial considerations.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Attachment: Redwood_Security_Exhibit_v2.docx (redlines, comments)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@healthsync.com>
Date: 2026-06-17T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit questions + pen test window options

Thanks Laura — operational clarifications from infra:

- We can offer a non-production staging window for most customers; where production testing is required we will require a scoped plan and a runbook.

- Pen tests that require elevated privileges or access to KV caches must be scheduled outside peak traffic windows; we suggest Mon–Thu 10:00–15:00 PST by default.

- Evidence exports: for the quarterly bundle we'll include aggregated alert summaries, change logs (config & deployments) for the agreed services, and a sampling of anonymized request traces. We can also provide a one-off deeper export for a validated legal request — expect a 7–10 business day turnaround.

I can prepare the ops stanza language to insert in the exhibit (timing, contact, runbook requirement).

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Infrastructure Product | Redwood Inference
Attachments: PenTest_Window_Options.xlsx (options / default slots)

From: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@healthsync.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-18T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit questions + pen test window options

Thanks — this is helpful and aligns with what Legal/Audit expected. Quick confirmations before we circulate to procurement:

- HealthSync accepts the 1 scoped inspection / 12-months approach, and the quarterly evidence bundle with the option for ad-hoc exports (we'll mark ad-hoc requests in the order form appendix).

- On pen tests: HealthSync will aim for the staging window where possible. For production-scoped tests we'll provide the runbook and pay any additional coordination fees if required. Please add an explicit escalation contact (email + phone) in the exhibit.

Can we get a redline that includes: (a) exhibit language for the inspection scope template, (b) a defined 72-hour test window + PST slots, and (c) the quarterly evidence export field list? If you can send the redline by EOD Monday we'll route to procurement for signature next week.

I'll attach a short procurement checklist for DocuSign routing after redlines.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Alice
Attachment: HealthSync_Procurement_Checklist.txt (text/plain)
